description: Evaluates candidate AI workflow ideas for business value, implementation readiness, repeatability, trust/control risk, warnings, and missing information.

aiIdea.description: Specific AI or automation idea the user wants evaluated.

businessContext.description: Short description of the business, customers, offer, and current operating context.

candidateUseCases.description: Candidate AI workflow ideas to evaluate.

anyOf.description: Short free-text description of an AI use case the user is considering.

availableData.description: Data, examples, documents, or systems available to support the use case.

currentControls.description: Existing human review, approval, QA, or escalation controls.

customerFacing.description: Whether the use case affects customers directly.

description.description: What the candidate use case would do.

expectedImpact.description: Expected business impact if the use case works well.

name.description: Short name of the candidate AI use case.

riskIfWrong.description: What could go wrong if the AI output or action is incorrect.

currentProblem.description: Main problem the AI opportunities should help solve.

currentWorkflow.description: Current workflow before AI or automation.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns about customer trust, brand risk, money, privacy, compliance, or quality control.

name: evaluate_ai_opportunities

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide to improve diagnostic confidence.

opportunities.description: Evaluated AI opportunities with value, readiness, risk, and control guidance.

businessValueScore.description: Relative business value score from 1 to 5.

implementationReadinessScore.description: Relative implementation readiness score from 1 to 5.

name.description: Short name of the AI opportunity.

recommendedFirstVersion.description: Safest narrow first version of the opportunity to pilot.

requiredHumanControl.description: Human review, approval, or escalation rule required for this opportunity.

summary.description: Public-safe explanation of the opportunity and why it matters.

trustRiskLevel.description: Estimated risk level for the workflow or recommendation.

recommendedFirstOpportunity.description: Best first opportunity to consider based on value, readiness, and risk.

warnings.description: Warnings about high-risk, premature, or unsafe automation patterns.

title: Evaluate AI Opportunities
